source_user: Advanced cluster case GDS-105: Evaluate GPUDirect Storage for checkpoint and dataset I/O in distributed training. Variant 105 must state assumptions, define a falsifiable hypothesis, name metrics, and include one failure or rollback condition.
source_assistant: An expert answer should distinguish model-domain mechanisms from runtime measurements. Required technical anchors: separate storage throughput from GPU DMA, validate filesystem and kernel support, measure queue depth and tail latency, compare CPU-staged I/O, and test restart consistency after interruption. It must report topology, workload, units, baselines, confounders, and evidence needed before claiming improvement.
corrected_answer: Use least-privilege, read-only preflight checks and disposable checkpoint copies; do not alter production data. State the assumption that filesystem, kernel, driver/runtime, container permissions, storage durability, and topology are unknown until measured. The falsifiable hypothesis is that an independently evidenced active GDS direct-GPU-DMA path lowers end-to-end I/O stall time or host CPU at fixed training work versus CPU-staged I/O, without worsening throughput, p99 latency, errors, checksum integrity, or interruption/node-loss recovery. Inventory GPU, PCIe, NIC/storage, NUMA and process/I/O affinity, filesystem and mount capabilities, versions, permissions, checkpoint format, and durability semantics. Measure storage throughput and GPU-DMA throughput separately in GB/s; end-to-end and stall time in ms; host CPU%, GPU idle%, queue depth, request rate, p50/p95/p99 latency, retries/errors, synchronized timestamps, checksum results, and recovery time. Use repeated randomized paired trials with stated sample count and variance or confidence intervals, and control cold versus warm cache, compression, request size, concurrency, and other workload contention. Require direct-path counters or an equivalent independent activation trace rather than inferring GDS from throughput. Quarantine outputs and immediately roll back to CPU staging if prerequisites are unsupported, activation evidence is absent, checksums differ, corruption or unsafe recovery appears, or a pre-registered latency/error/recovery threshold is breached.
risks: platform-specific GDS support and direct GPU-DMA activation are unverified
storage, transport, cache, compression, and application effects may be confounded
interruption or node failure may expose checkpoint integrity and recovery defects
evidence_required: topology and software/filesystem prerequisite inventory
matched CPU-staged and GDS trial logs with synchronized counters
independent direct GPU-DMA activation evidence
throughput, latency, utilization, queue-depth, error, checksum, and recovery measurements with uncertainty
